description.value: The View Winery & Vineyard is a family-owned estate winery housed in a restored 1920s apple packing house in East Kelowna, perched above Okanagan Lake with views of Black Knight and Dilworth Mountains. The winery has been on Ward family land for five generations and produces award-winning cool-climate whites, fruit-forward reds, and Wards Cider from its heritage orchards. Walk-in tastings are available seven days a week, and seasonal guided vineyard hikes, Sunday live music sessions, and occasional food trucks make it one of the more animated stops on the Okanagan wine route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates all OSM contact details. The winery is clearly open year-round for walk-in tastings with an on-site wine shop, Sunday food trucks are mentioned ('Food truck some Sundays'), and the Signature Experience includes charcuterie/picnic items available for on-site consumption. No bike-specific infrastructure (racks, pump, charging) or water refill services are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields default to null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, award-winning destination winery open year-round with walk-in tastings, retail wine and cider sales, food options, and seasonal events — a strong fit for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan wine route.
